name: testimonial-basic
blurb: Alternating grid of testimonials with video thumbnails and author details.
description: Two-column grid layout showing testimonials with video thumbnails and quote content. Rows alternate between video-left/text-right and text-left/video-right. Each includes author avatar, name, role, 5-star rating, and quote. Diagonal stripe pattern overlay on images.
use_when: Social proof pages where testimonials are video-centric or need visual dominance alongside written quotes.
avoid_when: When all testimonials are text-only — video thumbnails are prominent and take up 50% of space.
a11y: Images have alt text. Star ratings are decorative (no aria-labels for counts). Quote text is readable. Responsive on mobile collapses to single column.
